title: the dry-run card of haiku-explorer carries ROUTE-SCOPE: none, which parses to an empty list
source: intended: PLAN.md defect S1 (route_scope: [none] in jitso/presets/haiku-explorer.yaml)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect S1, route_scope). The router reads a scope with the regex (?:^|[.!?])[ \t>*-]*ROUTE-SCOPE:([^\n]*), so the card line must start with ROUTE-SCOPE: (with the colon, at a line start or after . ! ?) and list the build ids comma separated. On the TS binary today the card writes 'ROUTE-SCOPE <ids>' with no colon, after a '|' separator, so the matcher finds nothing and this case FAILS on TS. Here the build says [none], so the line must exist and name only none: route_scope [] (a missing line fails even []).
